eVasi Video Downloader %1$s saves public media to your Android gallery. Maintained by omryetimoglu.

Links you open are sent to the source platform and its media servers. Accepted downloads and their history are stored on this device. Clipboard detection runs when the app is in use. Sensitive clipboard content requires an explicit paste.\n\nX sign-in is optional. The app requests read access and keeps the session encrypted on this device. Sharing sends the file and any text you choose to the app you select in Android. You can clear history and cached previews independently in Storage.

Download and share only media you own or have permission to use. Respect the copyright, privacy and terms of the source platform. This app is for publicly accessible content. Availability depends on the source site and the formats it offers.
